diagnosis: Check C1 passed in all rollouts despite the decision-maker never having access to PF3. The model is defaulting to approving the $6,000,000 dividend (the public amount) without checking if it is actually authorized or if it preserves the debt-service reserve, which are only determined by PF3.

C1.why: PF3 changes the authorization from an unsupported payment to an approved $4,000,000 payment that preserves exactly $1,500,000 of debt-service reserve and adds the reserve commitment.
